objective: Plan safe cleanup of legacy path C:\AI_VAULT after runtime alignment to canonical C:\AI_VAULT_CANONICAL
why_cleanup_needed: Legacy path was accidentally mutated during a previous FAISS promotion front (ntotal changed from 1611 to 1616). Legacy semantic_memory.jsonl has 1711 lines vs 1715 in canonical, and legacy FAISS index SHA differs. Legacy is deprecated but contains data that should not be lost without backup.
what_not_to_do: Do NOT move files between legacy and canonical
Do NOT copy files to overwrite canonical
Do NOT modify memory/semantic/* in canonical
Do NOT modify memory/semantic/* in legacy
preconditions_for_future_execution: Runtime must not be using legacy path
Canonical FAISS must be verified as primary
Backup manifest of legacy must be created
User must provide exact approval phrase

backup_plan.step_1: Create full backup manifest of C:\AI_VAULT (SHA + counts)
backup_plan.step_2: Store manifest in tmp_agent evidence dir

rollback_plan.description: If quarantine rename breaks anything, rename back to C:\AI_VAULT
rollback_plan.condition: Only if canonical runtime fails after quarantine

execution_steps: Verify runtime not running or not using legacy
Create full backup manifest of legacy
Create README marker in quarantine dir explaining deprecated status
Update any hardcoded references if found
